message:
test(rel-0163 r2 E1): the PS and UA e2e through the PRODUCT renderer, checked on what DWM shows for the viewer window

Codex codex_rel_0163_evidence_r1.md E1. Test files only (apps/libs product sources unchanged; the 0.2.163
payload is not rebuilt).

--render [--shots <dir>]: the viewer's own window procedure presents (d3dPresentSuccessCount); the window is
placed off every monitor and read with Windows.Graphics.Capture (e2e_window_capture.hpp) -- PrintWindow gives
the GDI background of a flip-model window. UA: a WGC host, a layered target window whose colour changes at
each edge, secure <-> Default twice on one connection (28/28 x2). PS: picker 10 s -> desktop card pressed --
fails on the product: a pre-login host is never sent the window select, and the selection gate waits for its
ack (report_rel_0163_r2_e1_blocker.md).

Product / test / docs: product (none) / test (PS, UA render modes, window capture helper, windowsapp on the
two test targets) / docs (none).
